verdict.rationale: Summer Engine documents a first-party command-line flow: a single command configures agents, with flags such as --print, --dry-run, --scope, --channel and --cli. Its marketing also says agents can run the full publishing flow 'through the MCP or CLI'. The evidence covers only agent setup and a one-line publishing claim, so the depth of the CLI is unproven. missing for 10: a named CLI binary with install instructions, a full command reference beyond agent configuration, documented CLI commands for build/test/publish, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: One command configures any of these agents:
Add `--print` to see the snippet without writing anything, `--dry-run` to see the plan.
`--cli` installs the skills with no MCP server.
Your agent runs the whole publishing flow on Summer Games through the MCP or CLI.
